reported_status: The supplied combined transcript reports an internally derived classical-channel complete SLD certificate, a target-outcome-plus-one reference bound, a binary-input exact polynomial-time decision algorithm, and an exact three-input quantum-reference separation. It also reports a separate full-span perturbation obstruction. This intake preserved and routed the text only; no proof or script was independently reconstructed. scientific_scope_status: The candidate necessity theorem is restricted to finite classical channels, despite allowing arbitrary finite quantum references. The perturbation obstruction refutes a density/continuity proof route, not the unrestricted quantum common-lift conjecture.
